import bpy,json,collections
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector
c=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft']
records=[]
for o in c.objects:
 if o.type!='MESH':continue
 if o.name.startswith('M14') or any(s in o.name for s in ['rear_B floor','rear_B wall','rear_B foundation','rear_B waterfront shrub','rear_B door']) or o.name.startswith('Steel roof panel'):
  ps=[o.matrix_world@Vector(v) for v in o.bound_box]
  records.append({'name':o.name,'min':[round(min(p[i] for p in ps),3) for i in range(3)],'max':[round(max(p[i] for p in ps),3) for i in range(3)],'materials':[m.name for m in o.data.materials]})
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent
(root/'captures/shipyard_ground_20261115/source_resume.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
bank=bpy.data.objects['M14 continuous sculpted shore bank']
print(json.dumps({'ground14_built':c.get('ground14_built'),'bank':{'verts':len(bank.data.vertices),'faces':len(bank.data.polygons),'max_height':max(v.co.z for v in bank.data.vertices),'matrix':[list(v) for v in bank.matrix_world]},'samples':[r for r in records if not r['name'].startswith('Steel roof panel') and not r['name'].startswith('M14 bearing') and not r['name'].startswith('M14 working')][:25],'roof_count':sum(r['name'].startswith('Steel roof panel') for r in records)},ensure_ascii=False))
